title: Bartender, man in his 50s: slurring, stumbling, had a lot to drink

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The Blue Lantern bar, 3200 Geary Boulevard. One of our customers.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This guy, he's in his fifties, he's slurring his words and stumbling all over the place.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeah, he's had a lot to drink. Like six or seven beers and some shots.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is he awake and breathing normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He's awake, he's sitting on the floor by the door, he keeps trying to stand up.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was he last acting normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: About an hour ago, when he came in he was fine.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Keep him sitting down.
